name: Lauren Dunlap
role: Dakota Commissioner of Immigration, at Huron
bio: Lauren Dunlap was Dakota's Commissioner of Immigration, based at Huron, and the Cow Boy summarized his monthly bulletins on weather, crops and conditions in the territory in 1885 and 1886. His August 1886 bulletin complained that the territory's assessed valuation would have been higher had assessors followed the territorial secretary's directions.
